faq.q: Is my text sent to a server?

faq.a: Single line breaks (wrapped lines) are replaced with a space, while blank-line paragraph breaks are preserved — so your paragraphs stay separate but each one becomes a single line.
PDFs store text visually, line by line. Copying gives you those visual line breaks even where the sentence continues — this tool joins them back together.
faq.q: Why does text copied from PDFs have breaks everywhere?

heroSubtitle: Fix text copied from PDFs and emails: join wrapped lines back into clean paragraphs in one click.
metaDescription: Remove line breaks from text copied out of PDFs and emails. Join lines with spaces or keep paragraph breaks — free, private, runs in your browser.
title: Remove Line Breaks from Text — Free Online Tool | ToolVerse
whenNotToUse: It cannot tell a wrapped line from an intentional one — lists, addresses, poems, and code will be joined too unless you keep paragraph breaks and check the result.

Hyphenated words split across lines in a PDF (exam-
ple) are joined with the hyphen kept; you may need a quick find-and-replace pass for those.
